notes.AIA-RISK-01: E-mail spam classification (spamshield/classifier.py); no Art. 5 practice.
notes.AIA-RISK-02: README: minimal-risk, spam filtering is not an Annex III use case, no chatbot/generation.
notes.GDPR-LAW-01: docs/processing-record.md and privacy-note.md: legitimate interest Art. 6(1)(f) with LIA reference.
notes.GDPR-TRN-01: docs/privacy-note.md: controller/DPO, purpose, legal basis, retention, rights incl. complaint (published on intranet).
notes.GDPR-RET-01: Quarantine 30 days enforced by purge CronJob (k8s/deployment.yaml, quarantine.py); logs 180 days with hashed references only.
notes.GDPR-ERA-01: Quarantined mail auto-purged after 30 days and releasable by recipients, but no on-request erasure procedure.
notes.GDPR-PBD-01: classifier.normalise replaces addresses/URLs with tokens and truncates bodies; logs use hashed message_ref; only spam is stored.
notes.GDPR-SEC-01: Quarantine PV on KMS-encrypted StorageClass (disk-encryption-kms-key); mTLS with TLS 1.2 minimum (server.py).
notes.GDPR-SEC-02: Client-certificate (mTLS) required, NetworkPolicy allows only the postfix gateway.
notes.ACME-01: Quarantine digest (spamshield/digest.py) states messages were held by ACME's automated filter using a machine-learning model.
notes.ACME-03: Each classification logged with message ref, action, probability, model_version and 180-day retention, but no evidence of tamper protection (plain Loki sink) as POL-3(2) requires.
notes.ACME-04: Raw quarantined e-mails purged automatically after 30 days.
notes.ACME-06: Only endpoint requires a client certificate; no admin endpoints.
notes.ACME-08: MODEL_CARD.md with owner, version, intended/out-of-scope use, data, metrics, limitations.
notes.ACME-09: Per-client TokenBucket, requests_per_minute in config/spamshield.yaml (server.py, ratelimit.py).
notes.ACME-10: No AI incident response procedure in the repository.
